acip: DA LTAR RANG RES BLA MA MI'I GZUGS CAN DU MTHONG BA YANG DGA' RAB YIN TE, SPYAN SNGA BLO RGYAN GYIS, ,RANG RE'I LAS NGAN SGRIB PA'I CHE TSOD LA, ,BLA MA MI RU MTHONG BA'ANG DGA' TSAD YIN, ,KHYI DANG BONG BUR MA MTHONG BSOD NAMS CHE, ,MOS GUS SNYING NAS BSKYED CIG SH'AKYA'I SRAS, ,ZHES GSUNGS,
wylie: da ltar rang res bla ma mi'i gzugs can du mthong ba yang dga' rab yin te, spyan snga blo rgyan gyis, ,rang re'i las ngan sgrib pa'i che tshod la, ,bla ma mi ru mthong ba'ang dga' tshad yin, ,khyi dang bong bur ma mthong bsod nams che, ,mos gus snying nas bskyed cig shAkya'i sras, ,zhes gsungs
english: Even the fact that we can in our present condition see our Lama as a human being is quite an achievement.  As Chen-nga Lodru Gyeltsen once said, The fact that all of us, with the level Of bad deeds and obstacles that we have, Can even see our Lama as a human Is quite something of an achievement. It is our own great merit that we don't See Them as a dog, or a donkey. So feel love and reverence for Them, Deep from your hearts, Sons of the Shakya.
